records.context: A daemon thread takes one reading every effective ``interval`` seconds into a ring buffer of ``capacity`` samples. The default settings retain the most recent hour in memory; custom settings retain approximately ``capacity * interval`` seconds. A processing session that lasts a week therefore cannot grow the in-memory series without limit.

records.source: A daemon thread takes one reading every effective ``interval`` seconds into a ring buffer of ``capacity`` samples. The default settings retain the most recent hour in memory; custom settings retain approximately ``capacity * interval`` seconds. A run that lasts a week therefore cannot grow the in-memory series without limit.
records.translation: Bakgrunnsþráður tekur eina mælingu á hverju virku ``interval`` sekúndna bili og geymir hana í hringbiðminni sem rúmar ``capacity`` sýni. Sjálfgefnar stillingar geyma nýjustu klukkustundina í minni; sérsniðnar stillingar geyma um það bil ``capacity * interval`` sekúndur. Þess vegna getur vikulöng vinnslulota ekki látið röðina í minni vaxa án takmarkana.
